audience: teams who keep business data in Knack no-code database apps

useCases.title: Explain how an app is built
useCases.text: The AI lists the tables (objects) of the app and the fields of one table with name, type and required flag. You get a clear picture of the data model.

useCases.title: Read and filter the records of a table
useCases.text: The AI reads the records of a table with paging, sorting and filters, or one record by id. It reports totals and summarizes the rows.

useCases.title: Add a record to a table
useCases.text: The AI creates a new record from the field values you give, using the field keys of the table. Formula and auto-increment fields cannot be set.

useCases.title: Fix or update records one by one
useCases.text: The AI finds records and changes chosen fields on each. Only the fields you name are changed.

useCases.title: Delete records you no longer need
useCases.text: The AI finds a record and deletes it for good. This cannot be undone, so it should show you the record first.
